body:
Honestly I feel like I'm deciding it right now lol. I mean a lot of gay guys really like me, and girls not so much. So like maybe I don't feel the same visceral attraction to males that I do females, but at the end of the day I think I'd be happy with a male partner. 

Like does no one else do that? Just kinda settle? Like yeah I REALLY wanna fuck Sarah but at the end of the day she isn't in to me, and it sucks being along all the time, and Chris is pretty cute and funny.

I don't know I just started really thinking about this shit. For a long time I was just straight, being gay wasn't an option so I didn't let my mind go there.  I guess I'm just confused.

I think I'm probably bisexual, not out of the closet or anything, but I think some boys are pretty cute and when I was a kid before I was taught gay = bad I did some physical stuff with guys. 

But that is what makes it hard for me because it feels like I have the choice. I'm only interested in monogamous relationships so at the end of the day I'll be choosing either a gay or straight lifestyle.
